company_set: Ares; KKR; Apollo; Blackstone; BlackRock; Carlyle; Brookfield
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; quarterly supplement; BDC schedules; direct-lending releases
outside_data_sources: SEC company filings; rating reports; lender transaction notes
first_numbers_to_extract: credit AUM; direct lending AUM; gross deployment; originations; available capital; borrower count; portfolio fair value
derived_claim_test: Private-credit platforms are routing committed capital into real borrower loans rather than only reporting management-fee scale.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when platform-scale metrics and borrower/fund schedule evidence appear in the same period.
disproof_test: Weakens if AUM growth is mostly valuation, fee mix, or acquired AUM without fresh lending deployment.

company_set: Atwell; Precinmac; AeriTek; Frontline; Jiffy; MAI; Relation; Sunvair; Valcourt
primary_documents: BDC schedules; 8-K; credit agreement; merger proxy; sponsor release; rating report
outside_data_sources: UCC filings where available; rating-agency debt reports; law-firm deal notes
first_numbers_to_extract: facility size; funded principal; unfunded commitment; fair value; pricing; maturity; lender role; use of proceeds
derived_claim_test: Specific borrowers can be tied to specific private-credit instruments and holder vehicles.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when borrower, instrument, amount, date, and filing vehicle are all captured.
disproof_test: Weakens if only sponsor press language exists or holder rows cannot be mapped to a transaction.

company_set: MetLife; Prudential; Apollo/Athene; KKR/Global Atlantic; Brookfield Wealth Solutions
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; annual insurance report; statutory statement; quarterly supplement
outside_data_sources: NAIC InsData; state insurance departments; AM Best; S&P; Moody's; Fitch
first_numbers_to_extract: reserves; policyholder liabilities; invested assets; net investment income; spread income; rating mix; Schedule D; Schedule BA; capital and surplus
derived_claim_test: Insurance and retirement liabilities are becoming a durable upstream capital source for credit and private assets.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when liability scale and asset allocation are both quantified for the same insurer or platform.
disproof_test: Weakens if assets remain overwhelmingly public investment-grade bonds or private assets are immaterial.

outside_data_sources: CMS; state insurance filings; NAIC health filings if available
first_numbers_to_extract: premiums; medical costs payable; claims payable; operating cash flow; investment assets; MLR; PBM cash conversion
derived_claim_test: Managed-care companies create large timing balances and reinvestable cash, but not the same mechanism as annuity spread capital.
acceptance_rule: Promote only as cash-timing/float evidence, not as private-credit supply, unless investment allocation proves credit exposure.
disproof_test: Weakens if investment assets are small relative to claims obligations or cash flow is consumed by claims pressure.

company_set: NextEra; Duke; Constellation; Vistra; NRG; AEP; Exelon
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; investor deck; rate-case filing; earnings transcript
outside_data_sources: EIA; FERC; ISO/RTO interconnection queues; state utility commissions
first_numbers_to_extract: capex plan; rate base; allowed ROE; debt/equity issuance; MW/GW; contracted load; PPA terms; data-center/customer references
derived_claim_test: Power scarcity and electrification are turning capital into regulated and contracted power assets.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when demand commentary is tied to capex, rate-base, contracted load, or generation capacity numbers.
disproof_test: Weakens if capex is maintenance, demand language is generic, or projects lack approval/contract proof.

company_set: ONEOK; Targa; Plains; Energy Transfer; Cheniere
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; investor deck; project update; debt footnotes
outside_data_sources: EIA; FERC; PHMSA; export terminal data
first_numbers_to_extract: growth capex; pipeline miles; processing/fractionation capacity; export capacity; volumes; leverage; project debt; contracted volumes
derived_claim_test: Energy logistics remain a large capital destination with measurable physical assets and contracted throughput.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when project capex and capacity/volume additions are both visible.
disproof_test: Weakens if spend is maintenance, commodity-cycle replacement, or not linked to incremental throughput.

company_set: MasTec; Dycom; Primoris; Granite; ABM; CACI
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; backlog table; segment note; earnings transcript
outside_data_sources: state DOT awards; federal procurement data; broadband grant data
first_numbers_to_extract: backlog; funded awards; book-to-bill; working capital; customer concentration; margin; contract duration
derived_claim_test: Funded infrastructure projects show up as backlog and revenue visibility for contractors and technical-service firms.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when backlog is funded or award-backed and convertibility to revenue is described.
disproof_test: Weakens if backlog is unfunded, cancellable, low-margin, or produces working-capital drag.

company_set: PBF; Liberty Broadband; Matador; Devon; Coterra; CNX; Ovintiv; Cenovus; Enhabit; Wheaton
outside_data_sources: rating reports; lender releases; bond prospectuses
first_numbers_to_extract: old principal; new principal; coupon/spread; maturity; revolver capacity; drawn amount; repayment use; liquidity before/after
derived_claim_test: Refinancing documents show where capital changed maturity, lender mix, collateral, or liquidity risk.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when old and new instrument terms are both visible or use-of-proceeds names the debt repaid.
disproof_test: Weakens if financing is routine maturity extension with no change in risk, lender mix, or balance-sheet pressure.

company_set: Core & Main; Verizon; Sherwin-Williams; Lowe's; Rio Tinto; Expand Energy; Packaging Corp.; Silgan; Phillips 66; Roblox
primary_documents: 8-K; merger proxy; acquisition agreement; financing commitment; 10-K; 10-Q
outside_data_sources: rating reports; merger clearance filings; sponsor/law-firm deal notes
first_numbers_to_extract: transaction value; cash paid; debt issued; equity issued; bridge loan; target debt assumed/repaid; acquired revenue/assets/sites
derived_claim_test: M&A reveals capital flowing into control of assets, customers, reserves, routes, or capacity.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when transaction value and funding mix are disclosed.
disproof_test: Weakens if deals are small relative to the balance sheet or funded entirely by cash without a broader capital-market signal.

company_set: Synchrony; Target; Arrow; MSC Industrial; Pool; Dollar General; Zebra; Honeywell; Henry Schein; Global Industrial
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; securitization note; receivables trust filing; credit facility footnote
outside_data_sources: ABS deal data; rating presales; Fed consumer credit; supplier-finance disclosures
first_numbers_to_extract: receivables; inventory; securitized assets; warehouse lines; SPV debt; charge-offs; allowance; advance rates; retained interests
derived_claim_test: Operating assets become financeable pools when receivables, loans, leases, or inventory are pledged or securitized.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when a financing structure is disclosed, not merely because working capital exists.
disproof_test: Weakens if balances are ordinary trade working capital without collateralized funding or credit-risk transfer.

company_set: Eaton; Jacobs; AECOM; United Rentals; Steel Dynamics; Nucor; Knife River; Reliance; KBR; Teledyne
primary_documents: 10-K; 10-Q; investor deck; segment backlog; capex table
outside_data_sources: Census construction spending; EIA; DOE; public infrastructure awards
first_numbers_to_extract: capex; backlog; orders; capacity additions; utilization; tons shipped; rental fleet OEC; free cash flow; debt issued/repaid
derived_claim_test: Capital is being absorbed by companies that turn funded demand into equipment, materials, projects, or throughput.
acceptance_rule: Promote only when capital spend or orders are connected to capacity, utilization, or revenue conversion.
disproof_test: Weakens if growth is price-only, replacement-only, or not tied to funded end-market demand.

derived_claim_test: The broad thesis should be assembled only from repeated instrument-level and source-to-use evidence across lanes.
